title: Arabidopsis Spaceflight Omics: LASSO Biomarker Discovery and Single-Cell Atlas Integration
description:
A multi-track computational pipeline for identifying spaceflight-responsive biomarker genes in Arabidopsis thaliana using NASA OSDR transcriptomic data, validating them against a single-cell seedling atlas with scPlantLLM, and characterizing cell-cell communication patterns with PlantCellChat.

Track 1 builds an 85-gene LASSO biomarker panel (leave-one-study-out CV AUC = 0.734) from 156 pooled bulk RNA-seq samples across six OSDR studies. Track 2 applies the scPlantLLM plant foundation model in zero-shot mode to a 9,998-cell seedling atlas and documents cross-tissue domain shift. Track 3 infers cell-cell communication, finding Ca2+ signaling dominant (strength 249.5), resolves a CBL9-CIPK23-AKT1 Ca2+/K+ crosstalk circuit with guard cells as the primary hub, and maps results onto plant anatomy with ggPlantmap. Includes the full analysis code, data tables, 8 main figures, 48 supplementary figures, 26 supplementary tables, supplementary methods, and the manuscript prepared for npj Microgravity.

creators.name: Barker, Richard
creators.affiliation: GeneLab Plant Analysis Working Group, NASA Open Science Data Repository

notes: Data sources: NASA OSDR studies OSD-37, OSD-678, OSD-38, OSD-321, OSD-120, OSD-624 (bulk RNA-seq); GEO GSE226097 seed-to-seed single-cell atlas (Lee et al., Nature Plants 2025). Methods build on scPlantLLM (Cao et al., 2025), PlantCellChat, and ggPlantmap (Jo & Kajala, 2024). Results are discovery-only; no external validation cohort.
